focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文收尾段：跳出简单重复，完成核心权衡整合与边界升华（Synthesis Conclusion）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 结尾段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [重申核心权衡与立场 Restate Nuanced Thesis]：In conclusion, while [Acknowledged Factor A] introduces real challenges in [Specific Aspect], [Core Thesis Stance] remains the most viable path forward.
S2 [整合全文两大支柱机制 Synthesize Dual Pillars]：By combining [Pillar 1 from Body 1] with [Pillar 2 / Safeguard from Body 2], [Actors] can harness [Core Benefit] while containing [Primary Risk].
S3 [理性边界展望（可选）Grounded Forward Look]：Ultimately, the success of [Technology/Policy] depends not on its standalone capability, but on the institutional rigor with which it is governed.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Balanced Restatment -> Dual-Pillar Synthesis -> Grounded Governance Principle (Zero Slogans!). 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. We should make full use of its advantages and avoid its disadvantages. Let us work hand in hand to welcome a bright future of AI!
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 结尾段最忌讳的三句废话全中：既有好处也有坏处 + 扬长避短 + 让我们携手共创美好未来（口号感叹句）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Abstract 与 Introduction 立意与破题（BP01–BP08）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 亮出本文核心洞察与破局方法总览（Key Insight & Method Overview）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在指出前人痛点后，正式亮出我们的方法（To address this dilemma, we propose...），并用最通俗清晰的直觉告诉审稿人为什么我们的设计能破局。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Introduction 第三段（Our Approach & Key Insight）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [方法登场与定位 Method Introduction]：To address this dilemma, we propose [Model Name], a [Core Paradigm] framework that [Primary Goal].
S2 [核心直觉洞察 Key Insight]：Our key insight is that [Physical/Statistical Principle]，点破破局的底层支点。
S3 [模块协同主干 Module Synergy]：用 First / Specifically 与 Concurrently / Furthermore 简述两大核心模块如何分工咬合。
S4 [闭环收益总结 Closed-Loop Benefit]：说明这种协同设计如何同时兼顾原先冲突的两个指标（如兼顾平稳表征与幅值保真，或兼顾多模态多样性与单步实时控制）。
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Problem Anchor -> Key Insight -> Dual-Module Mechanism -> Pareto Resolution. 绑定逻辑规则：L002, L023.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In this paper, we propose a novel and groundbreaking model called DyTS-Net. It has three modules: Module A, Module B, and Module C. They work together to delve into the data and get state-of-the-art performance.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 典型 AI 自吹词（novel and groundbreaking, delve into, state-of-the-art）；② 机械报菜名（Module A, B, C），完全没讲清为什么这套组合能解决上一段的痛点。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: To resolve this dilemma, we propose DyTS-Net, a dual-stream forecasting architecture that decouples stationary structural modeling from dynamic scale trajectory estimation. Our key insight is that while high-frequency phase relationships benefit from normalized shift-invariant attention, macro-scale amplitude evolution follows a low-dimensional continuous dynamical system. Specifically, DyTS-Net first extracts scale-invariant temporal tokens via spectral patch attention, and concurrently models non-stationary mean-variance evolution through a lightweight neural ODE branch. Recombining both streams at the decoding stage preserves sharp peak magnitudes without sacrificing training stability.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 学术演讲开场 60 秒 Hook：用直观痛点或反直觉现象抓住全场（Oral Opening Hook）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想作为顶会 Oral Presentation、组会汇报或博士面试 PPT 第一页的开场白：在 45–60 秒内不用任何晦涩公式，让全场听众立刻听懂“我们为什么要做这件事、现有方法到底卡在哪”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Tech Talk / Conference Oral / 组会开场逐字稿（Slide 1–2）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [场景直觉切入 Concrete Scenario Hook]：Good morning everyone. Imagine deploying a humanoid robot to assemble flexible cables on a moving factory line—or forecasting grid load when a storm hits.
S2 [反直觉痛点设问 Counter-intuitive Breakdown]：Standard deep models perform remarkably well when conditions stay calm, yet why do they fail abruptly the moment contact dynamics or weather patterns shift?
S3 [一针见血揭晓答案 Crisp Root Cause]：The culprit is a hidden stationarity assumption baked into standard attention layers.
S4 [亮出今日主旨 Talk Roadmap]：In this talk, I will show how our framework, [Model Name], breaks this bottleneck and achieves [Key Metric Gain] in real-time deployment.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Concrete Visual Scenario -> Rhetorical Question -> Crisp Culprit Identification -> Talk Promise. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Hello everyone, my name is XXX. Today the title of my presentation is 'Adaptive De-stationary Spectral-Spatial Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting'. First I will talk about background, second methodology, third experiments, and finally conclusion.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 最催眠的开场方式：念一遍长标题 + 报一遍八股目录（First background, second methodology...），台下听众前 30 秒就开始看手机。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Good morning everyone. Suppose you are operating a regional wind-power grid when a sudden cold front sweeps across the turbines. Standard Transformer forecasters look accurate during calm weather, yet why do their predictions lag by hours right when the storm hits? The culprit is instance normalization: in trying to stabilize attention weights, it strips away the exact amplitude surges needed to predict peak loads. In the next five minutes, I will show how our model, DyTS-Net, resolves this trade-off—cutting extreme-weather forecasting error by 17% while running twice as fast.

focal_logic_rules.category: Precision & Grounding (精确度与实证落地)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 定量实证三元组：指标 + 基线 + 边界条件（Metric-Baseline-Condition Triad）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 任何宣称“更好、更快、更鲁棒、影响深远”的句子，必须同时交代三个维度：① 具体评估指标与幅度（Metric & Magnitude）、② 对比参照系（Baseline）、③ 评测工况或数据集条件（Condition）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Method/Policy] improves/reduces [Metric] by [Exact %/Value] compared with [Strongest Baseline] under [Specific Dataset/Horizon/Noise Regime].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只写 significantly improves performance 或 achieves state-of-the-art results，属于典型的“不精确 + 空洞夸张”。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Our generative policy achieves much better success rates and runs much faster than previous methods.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Our consistency-distilled policy increases bimanual peg-insertion success rates from 64% to 89% while cutting inference latency from 180 ms to 12 ms relative to a 50-step DDPM baseline.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 64%->89%（指标）、180ms->12ms（延迟）、relative to a 50-step DDPM baseline（基线）和 bimanual peg-insertion（任务条件）彻底消灭空洞形容词。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Spoken Rhythm, Visual Anchoring, and Rhetorical Signposting
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 听众无法像读论文那样倒回去重读长定语从句。把书面段转化为演讲稿时，必须：① 砍掉多重嵌套从句，拆为 10–15 词的清晰短句；② 先给视觉坐标（Look at the red curve in the upper-right panel）再讲结论；③ 用轻量设问（Why does this spike happen? Because...）引导注意力。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Visual Anchor: Turning to the right panel of Slide 4,] -> [Short Rhetorical Question: why does the baseline diverge after step 50?] -> [Crisp Causal Answer: The answer lies in compound orientation drift.]
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 拿着书面论文原封不动照念长达 40 个词的复合句，台下听众在前 10 秒就丢失了主谓关系。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: As illustrated in Figure 4, the trajectory generated by the baseline model without temporal consistency regularization exhibits substantial oscillation around the target waypoint.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Take a look at the dashed blue trajectory in Figure 4. Notice how violently the robot arm oscillates near the target waypoint. Why does this happen? Without temporal consistency regularization, adjacent action chunks conflict with one another.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Take a look at... -> Notice how... -> Why does this happen? -> Without X, Y conflicts... 营造极具现场掌控力的母语级 Tech Talk 节奏。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. We should make full use of its advantages and avoid its disadvantages. Let us work hand in hand to welcome a bright future of AI!

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L010 定量实证三元组：指标 + 基线 + 边界条件（Metric-Baseline-Condition Triad））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 结尾段最忌讳的三句废话全中：既有好处也有坏处 + 扬长避短 + 让我们携手共创美好未来（口号感叹句）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.

focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想配合论文里的 Figure 2（模型总架构图），用一段话把输入张量从左到右流经各个模块直到输出预测结果的完整全貌讲清楚。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Figure 2 shows our model. There is a Patch Encoder on the left. In the middle, there is a Spectral Block and a Graph Block. On the right, a Linear Decoder outputs the result.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L030 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 写成看图说话的静态空间方位描述（on the left, in the middle, on the right），没有体现张量变换的数据流动与功能因果。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DyTS-Net, which maps raw sensor streams to multi-horizon forecasts through three sequential stages. Given an input sequence $\mathbf{X}$, the Adaptive De-stationary Tokenizer first separates local trend-scale statistics from normalized sub-series patches $\mathbf{Z}_0$. These normalized patches then pass through stacked Spectral-Spatial Mixing blocks, which jointly filter high-frequency channel noise in the Fourier domain and propagate cross-sensor phase dependencies via a sparse directed graph. Finally, the Scale-Guided Decoder fuses the refined structural representations with the projected neural-ODE scale trajectory to reconstruct the multi-horizon output $\hat{\mathbf{Y}}$.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Table 1 reports the multivariate forecasting results, where DyTS-Net secures the lowest error in 25 out of 28 dataset-horizon configurations. Compared with channel-independent PatchTST, DyTS-Net reduces average MSE by 14.2% on the 862-channel Traffic benchmark, where modeling spatial-temporal congestion propagation across adjacent road sensors is critical. Furthermore, while variate-mixing iTransformer performs competitively at $H=96$, its MSE escalates by 68% at $H=720$ on volatile Weather series as unregularized cross-channel attention overfits transient wind gusts. By decoupling stationary phase coupling from neural-ODE scale projection, DyTS-Net suppresses long-horizon drift and maintains an 11.6% margin over the strongest baseline at $H=720$.
